build_inputs.angles:
A name born on the racetrack: “718” honors Porsche’s lightweight racers of the 1950s, including the 718 RSK that won the 1959 Targa Florio.
Air intakes beside your ears: Intakes replace the rear quarter windows, feeding the engine while bringing its induction soundtrack directly into the cabin.
Race-inspired Weissach details: Exposed carbon fiber and titanium exhaust tips inspired by the Porsche 935 complement a swan-neck rear wing with technology derived from the 911 RSR racer.
GT3 heart, Cayman body: Its naturally aspirated 4.0-liter flat-six comes from the 911 GT3, delivering 493 horsepower and a screaming 9,000-rpm redline.

listing_facts.title: 2023 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS Weissach Package

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2023 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS Weissach Package, finished in paint-to-sample Maritime Blue with a black and blue interior. The odometer on this Cayman GT4 RS currently displays approximately 6,500 miles. This Porsche is offered with a clean Carfax vehicle history report. A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes the Weissach and Sport Chrono packages, a front-axle lift system, Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB), and a Bose sound system. The seller reports no notable modifications. Introduced in 2022, the Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS boasts a naturally aspirated 4.0-liter flat-6 engine derived from the 911 GT3, featuring a 9,000-rpm redline, six individual throttle bodies, and a carbon fiber airbox mounted directly behind the driver and passenger. The sole transmission choice is a 7-speed PDK with shortened gear ratios compared to the standard GT4. Power comes from a 4.0-liter flat-6, rated at 493 horsepower and 331 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transmission.
